{{Top|leg}}
A '''transpond marker tracker''' was a device capable of receiving signals from a [[transpond marker]]. The [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] [[Gamgalon]] carried a tracker to locate his [[Yagaran aleudrupe plant]] crops on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]].
